title: Recall elections (research briefing SN05089)
context: The first recall petition under the Recall of MPs Act 2015, held after Ian Paisley's 30-sitting-day suspension for breaching the Code of Conduct for MPs; run by the Chief Electoral Officer for Northern Ireland. 7,543 signatures were needed, so the petition fell 444 short and he kept the seat. Signatures are those validly made at one of three signing places, by post, or by proxy.

title: Recall of MPs Act 2015: Member for Peterborough, notification to the Speaker, 1 May 2019
context: Held after Fiona Onasanya was sentenced to three months in prison for perverting the course of justice. The Petition Officer rejected 62 signing sheets as unmarked or void for uncertainty. The seat was vacated and the by-election was held on 6 June 2019.

title: Recall of MPs Act 2015: Member for Brecon and Radnorshire, notification to the Speaker, 21 June 2019
context: Held after Chris Davies was convicted of providing false or misleading information for a parliamentary allowances claim. The Petition Officer rejected 41 signing sheets as unmarked or void for uncertainty. The seat was vacated and the by-election was held on 1 August 2019.

title: Recall of MPs Act 2015: Member for Rutherglen and Hamilton West, notification to the Speaker, 1 August 2023
context: Held after Margaret Ferrier's suspension from the House for breaching Covid-19 restrictions. The Petition Officer rejected 37 signing sheets as unmarked. The signing period opened on 20 June 2023 (from the Electoral Commission's report; the notification gives the 31 July close). The Electoral Commission's report prints 81,124 eligible signers once, against the Petition Officer's 81,123. The by-election was held on 5 October 2023.

title: Recall of MPs Act 2015: Member for Wellingborough, notification to the Speaker, 19 December 2023
context: Held after Peter Bone's six-week suspension for breaching Parliament's bullying and harassment and sexual misconduct policies. The Petition Officer rejected 82 signing sheets as unmarked or void for uncertainty. The by-election was held on 15 February 2024. A recall petition against Scott Benton (Blackpool South) opened on 12 March 2024 and was terminated on 25 March 2024 when he resigned; it never reached a count and is not loaded.
